About.title: About Anime2Cap
About.question: <bold>Anime2Cap</bold> exists to answer a question every fan has asked:
About.quote: "I finished episode X. Which chapter should I continue from in the manga?"
About.description: Instead of hunting for answers in forums and getting spoilers, you find everything here in seconds. Our goal is to facilitate your transition between media in a precise and direct way.
About.searchDesc: Type the anime name and get results instantly, without reloading the page.
About.conversionDesc: We map episodes and chapters with a focus on absolute precision, identifying what is <canon>Canon</canon> and what is <filler>Filler</filler>.
About.footerNote: Our focus is your experience. No technical jargon, no distractions. Just the information you need to continue your journey in the world of manga.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At Anime2Cap, your privacy is our priority. This policy explains how we handle information.
Privacy.sec1Content: We do not collect personally identifiable information (PII) from users. There is no need to create an account to use the site.
Privacy.sec2Content: We may use basic technical cookies to remember your language preferences and improve site performance.
Privacy.sec3Content: We use third-party APIs (such as Jikan) to provide anime data. These services may have their own privacy policies.
Privacy.sec4Content: We implement commercially acceptable security measures to protect our site data and the integrity of your browsing experience.
Privacy.sec5Content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We recommend that you review this page periodically for any changes.
